actual_evidence: The continuous extraction and protection of these furanics in an immiscible organic solvent drastically reduce the amount of side reactions between the furanics and the acid present in the aqueous phase. ｜ Later, the excess of HCl present in the acidic sugar solution after hydrolysis is enough to produce CMF in high yields using halogenated organic solvents (e.g., chlorobenzene) in biphasic reactors.
explanation: 必需事实（不混溶有机溶剂原位/连续萃取 CMF）被直接陈述：块内先给出双相体系中不混溶有机溶剂连续萃取的原理，随后又逐字描述本文（Avantium）自身工艺——用卤代有机溶剂在双相反应器中由酸性糖液高产率制取 CMF。块来源即题目点名的 2023 CMF 论文 → 覆盖单一必需事实 → 3，维持原判。
review_basis: 原题+必需事实+硬性来源限定+完整原块阅读

actual_evidence: in this study, the acid−sugar solutions from saccharification were heated directly to convert the sugars into furanics without any prior purification... These furanic compounds are obtained using a biphasic system composed of the saccharide acidic solution and a nonmiscible organic solvent, in which the CMF and furfural were continuously extracted... By doing so, the separation of furanics in the organic solvent from the acid becomes a simple phase separation.
explanation: 同一篇 2023 CMF 论文的重叠块，逐字给出『不混溶有机溶剂 + 连续萃取 CMF + 简单相分离』，必需事实完整覆盖 → 3，维持原判。
review_basis: 原题+必需事实+硬性来源限定+完整原块阅读

actual_evidence: Lignocellulosic biomass is the most available carbon source, and a first requirement for its valorization is the complete saccharification of its sugar-bearing components. HCl-based technologies can achieve this at 20 °C and ambient pressure. These principles were disclosed in the 1920s... Avantium Chemicals B.V. developed a modern version of this “Bergius” highly concentrated acid hydrolysis, in which the saccharides in HCl are transformed into furanics without any prior purification
explanation: 必需事实含三项：fuming HCl、low temperature、one single step。块内覆盖两项——『highly concentrated acid hydrolysis』『HCl-based』≈浓盐酸，『20 °C and ambient pressure』= 低温；但全文没有任何『one single step / 单步水解』的表述（只提到『first requirement is the complete saccharification』）。缺一项 → 最高 2。旧判 3 过高。
review_basis: 原题+必需事实+硬性来源限定+完整原块阅读

actual_evidence: The hydrolysate of the biphasic fractionation step was used at identical conditions with and without 2-MTHF as a second liquid phase. The in situ extraction of furfural into 2-MTHF at low xylose conversion (9%; at 168°C, 10 min) led to a selectivity of >80%... it enables a straightforward downstream processing, as furfural can be isolated by evaporation of 2-MTHF
explanation: 必需事实要求点明两种溶剂（water 与 2-MTHF）。该块反复出现 2-MTHF（第二液相、萃取相、可蒸发回收），但全块通篇未出现 water 一词，另一相只以 the hydrolysate / 水相含义隐含表达。两种溶剂只明确命名一种 → 部分覆盖 → 2。旧判 3 过高（旧理由本身也只说确认了 2-MTHF 一相）。

actual_evidence: Figure 1. Biomass fractionation and integrated furfural production using phosphoric acid as catalyst. The process consists of a swelling step of dried lignocellulosic biomass at 80°C, followed by a biphasic fractionation step, using water and 2-MTHF as solvents.
explanation: 图 1 图注逐字写出『using water and 2-MTHF as solvents』，两种溶剂齐备，来源即题目点名的 2021 磷酸法论文 → 3，维持原判。

actual_evidence: In the fractionation step, the acid is diluted with water to 8 wt%. 2-MTHF (equal volume to the aqueous phase) is added as a second phase, resulting in a biomass loading of 100 gL 1 referring to the aqueous phase. ｜ After removing the organic phase and the solid pulp, new 2MTHF (equal volume to the aqueous phase) is added to the hydrolysate
